label-sync.description: Live label + alias bus (§11.4.182): read the current `(T<N>/<branch> - <alias> - <model> - <effort>)` label, list labelled sessions/agents/shells, switch the operator's active alias (all followers relabel immediately), register/heartbeat/finish an entity. Decoupled Go stdio MCP server (protocol 2024-11-05), stdlib only (§11.4.28).
